answer: Work waits on the delta until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wharf of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the juniper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
